**Findings:** s361 relay 2026-10-18: `vcs.move` in move_slice/commit_stage raises a raw OS error when the source file is gone; the `expects_body` closure keeps the load-time Index after apply_outline publish or a TUI reload; tests/test_store_lazy.py:150 comment is stale; Index.get is a linear scan per miss · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

## Why

s361 mapped a missing file on read to `corrupt`. A slice move still raises a raw `FileNotFoundError` when the file vanished between load and rename.
